title: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Reported by Sen. Tim Scott (R-SC) with an amendment in the nature of a substitute; placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders, Calendar No. 423.

substituteWarning: The Senate text is a full strike-and-replace substitute (now a merged 616-page Banking+Agriculture draft). If the Senate passes H.R. 3633, the bill goes back to the House for re-passage of the amended text - it does NOT send the House-passed CLARITY text to the President. A cloture vote is not a passage vote.
